## The optional `diagram-renderer` image

`ghcr.io/zennthic/elefant/diagram-renderer` is a separate, optional image that
renders Mermaid diagrams for the MCP diagram tools. It contains mermaid (same
version as above, MIT), puppeteer-core (Apache-2.0), their npm dependencies,
and Chromium from Debian's package archive. Its own notices are generated at
image build time by `diagram-renderer/scripts/license-scan.mjs` from the
lockfile actually installed, written to `/app/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` inside
the image, and the build fails on a license outside the allow list. Chromium's
notices are at `/usr/share/doc/chromium/copyright` in the image. It does not use
`@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli`, whose 11.x line depends on the EPL-2.0 `elkjs`
layout engine; it drives mermaid in headless Chromium directly instead.

## The `diagram-validator` image

`ghcr.io/zennthic/elefant/diagram-validator` is a separate image that parses
Mermaid diagrams for the MCP diagram tools, with no browser. It contains mermaid
(same version as above, MIT), linkedom (ISC) and their npm dependencies on
Debian's Node base image. Its own notices are generated at image build time by
`diagram-validator/scripts/license-scan.mjs` from the lockfile actually
installed, written to `/app/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` inside the image, and the
build fails on a license outside the allow list. It does not use jsdom, whose
dependencies include MIT-0 packages, a license not on that list.

## Loaded at runtime, not redistributed

The web UI loads these from a public CDN in the browser. Elefant does not ship
copies of them, so they are listed for information only:
SortableJS 1.15.6 (MIT), three.js 0.158.0 (MIT), three-spritetext 1.8.2 (MIT),
3d-force-graph 1.74.5 (MIT).
